I am writing to refer this patient urgently under the urology suspected cancer pathway. He presents with a two-week history of visible haematuria on two separate occasions; he describes frank red urine without associated pain.

I have sent a mid-stream urine sample which returned negative for infection. He has a background of recurrent urinary tract infection managed for two years, but this presentation is different: the haematuria is visible, painless, and unprovoked. I have also noted an abnormal ultrasound of the renal tract from four months ago showing mild irregularity of the right renal pelvis. His Prostate specific antigen was 2.8 ng/mL three months ago, within the age-appropriate range at that time.
